issues.title: Concurrency on Shared State
issues.why: While it references spec/13 for concurrency, it mentions local SQLite state (~/.local/state/glci/) which contradicts the 'stateless' claim in 02-architecture.md.
issues.fix: Clarify if the CLI is truly stateless or if it uses a local cache for specific features like 'glci config set'.
